title: Smile Makeover in NYC
copy:
Smile makeover in NYC starts with a plan for your teeth, bite and goals. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, a makeover may combine porcelain veneers, Invisalign and laser teeth whitening, depending on what each tooth needs.

Dr. Pia evaluates the full arch, gum line and the way your upper and lower teeth meet before recommending treatment. When alignment needs correction, it comes before porcelain placement. No-drill veneers require suitable alignment and a stable bite.

Explore the treatment options and consultation process at the Manhattan practice. Your sequence is determined after a diagnostic evaluation and X-ray review.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/smile-makeover/

#SmileMakeover #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: A sequenced combination of veneers, Invisalign and whitening
Full arch, gum line and bite evaluation
Alignment precedes porcelain when needed; no-drill candidacy depends on alignment and bite
Diagnostic evaluation and X-ray review
limits: Treatment selection is individual; no-drill veneers require suitable alignment and a stable bite.

title: No Drill Veneers in NYC
copy:
No-drill veneers in NYC use ultra-thin porcelain shells bonded to the front of natural teeth without removing enamel. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, the shells are handmade to account for the color, texture and translucency of surrounding teeth.

This approach adds porcelain to the tooth surface, so candidacy matters. Correct alignment and a stable bite are required; adding thickness alone cannot correct crowded or rotated teeth. Dr. Pia evaluates these requirements before approving no-prep treatment.

Read about no-drill veneers, the consultation and the options discussed after a diagnostic evaluation and X-ray review at the Manhattan practice.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/no-drill-veneers-nyc/

#NoDrillVeneers #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Ultra-thin porcelain bonded without enamel removal
Handmade porcelain matched for color, texture and translucency
Correct alignment and stable bite required; additions alone cannot correct crowding or rotation
Diagnostic evaluation and X-ray review
limits: No-prep veneers add material; correct alignment and a stable bite are required. No guarantee of candidacy, reversibility or outcome is promoted.

title: Porcelain Veneers in NYC
copy:
Porcelain veneers in NYC can address chips, gaps, worn edges and discoloration by changing the visible surface of a tooth. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, handmade feldspathic porcelain veneers are designed at the Park Avenue South practice in Manhattan.

A master ceramist layers the porcelain by hand. Before treatment, Dr. Pia evaluates alignment, bite and existing tooth structure to determine which approach fits your case. Veneers do not treat decay, infection or structural failure; those concerns require restorative care first.

Explore the veneer options and learn what is reviewed during a consultation, including whether alignment treatment is needed before porcelain placement.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/porcelain-veneers/

#PorcelainVeneers #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Veneers address chips, gaps, worn edges and discoloration
Handmade feldspathic porcelain layered by a master ceramist
Alignment, bite and tooth structure determine candidacy
Decay, infection and structural failure require treatment first
limits: Veneers do not treat decay, infection or structural failure. Alignment and bite are evaluated before treatment.

title: Anti Aging Dentistry in NYC
copy:
Anti-aging dentistry in NYC, also called facelift dentistry, focuses on rebuilding worn or shortened teeth and correcting the bite. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, treatment is planned around the dental structures that support the lower face.

The plan may include porcelain restorations and orthodontic alignment, depending on tooth wear and bite position. Dr. Pia restores missing or compromised back teeth before placing front veneers. Candidates need adequate gum health, and misaligned arches are addressed before restorative work.

Read about this non-surgical dental approach and arrange a consultation to discuss whether your tooth structure and bite make it appropriate for you.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/anti-aging-dentistry-nyc/

#AntiAgingDentistry #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Facelift dentistry rebuilds worn or shortened teeth and corrects the bite
Dental height and position support the lower face
Porcelain restorations and orthodontic alignment may be combined
Back teeth restored before front veneers; adequate gum health and alignment required
limits: Candidate evaluation is required. No promise of facial rejuvenation or equivalence to a surgical facelift. The website card is an illustrative image, not a patient before-and-after.

title: Gum Contouring in NYC
copy:
Gum contouring in NYC reshapes excess gum tissue to reveal more of the natural tooth surface and adjust the proportions of your smile. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, laser gum recontouring is planned around the position and shape of each tooth's gum line.

An uneven gum line or increased gum display can have several causes. Dr. Pia identifies the cause before recommending a procedure. Cosmetic contouring requires healthy gum tissue; active periodontal infection must be treated first, and concerns involving bone or jaw position may require specialist care.

Explore gum design and the consultation process at the Manhattan practice to learn which approach may suit your smile.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/gum-design-nyc/

#GumContouring #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Reshaping excess gum tissue reveals natural tooth surface
Laser recontouring planned around individual gum contours
The cause of gum display determines treatment
Healthy tissue required; infection treated first; bone and skeletal cases may require referrals
limits: Healthy gum tissue is required. Active periodontal infection and bone or jaw-position causes need appropriate care before or instead of cosmetic reshaping.

title: Lip Augmentation in NYC
copy:
Lip augmentation in NYC can address lip volume, asymmetry and border definition with hyaluronic acid filler. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, planning considers lip anatomy, tooth position and facial proportions before treatment is scheduled.

Dr. Pia assesses suitability through a clinical evaluation. Candidates need good general health, realistic expectations and no active infection near the mouth. Filler is deferred during pregnancy or breastfeeding and for certain infections or known allergies. Swelling and bruising can occur.

Explore the lip enhancement page and arrange a consultation at the Manhattan practice. Discuss your goals, the appropriate product and treatment risks before deciding.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/lip-augmentation-botox-fillers/

#LipAugmentation #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Hyaluronic acid filler addresses lip volume, asymmetry and definition

Good health, realistic expectations, infection and pregnancy restrictions
Swelling and bruising can occur
limits: Clinical evaluation is required; pregnancy, breastfeeding, active infections and relevant allergies restrict candidacy. Swelling and bruising can occur. No promise of safety or a particular appearance.

title: Laser Teeth Whitening in NYC
copy:
Laser teeth whitening in NYC uses a professional peroxide gel activated by a dental laser to address discoloration on natural teeth. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, Dr. Pia personally performs each whitening treatment at the Manhattan practice.

Enamel condition, gum health and existing restorations are evaluated before treatment. Whitening does not change the shade of porcelain veneers, crowns or composite restorations. Untreated decay, active gum disease and exposed root surfaces must be addressed first. Temporary sensitivity and gum irritation can occur.

Read about the in-office procedure and consultation to learn whether whitening fits your teeth and the changes you want to make.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/laser-teeth-whitening/

#LaserTeethWhitening #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Professional peroxide gel activated by a dental laser treats natural-tooth discoloration

Sensitivity and gum irritation can occur; contraindications addressed first
limits: Whitening does not change restoration color. Untreated decay, active gum disease and exposed roots must be addressed first. Temporary sensitivity and gum irritation can occur. No shade-change guarantee.

title: Invisalign in NYC
copy:
Invisalign in NYC uses a sequence of custom, removable clear aligners to move teeth toward a planned position. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, Invisalign is used as a foundation treatment before no-drill veneers, with the restorative goal considered during planning.

Dr. Pia evaluates crowding, spacing, tooth rotation and the bite to determine candidacy. Teeth and gums must be healthy before aligner treatment begins, and some skeletal discrepancies require a different approach. The trays are worn 20 to 22 hours each day, with consistent wear essential to the treatment plan.

Explore the consultation and treatment stages at the Manhattan practice, including how alignment connects to the cosmetic work that follows.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/invisalign/

#Invisalign #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC

Invisalign is a foundation before no-drill veneers at this practice
Clinical candidacy requires healthy teeth and gums and assessment of skeletal discrepancies
Daily wear of 20 to 22 hours
limits: Foundation treatment before veneers rather than an unrestricted standalone offer. Healthy teeth and gums and clinical assessment required; consistent wear affects treatment.

title: Dental Crowns in NYC
copy:
Dental crowns in NYC provide full coverage when a tooth needs more support than a filling, inlay or veneer can offer. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, porcelain crowns are designed for prepared natural teeth or dental implant abutments.

Dr. Pia reviews X-rays, assesses your bite and considers more conservative restorations before recommending a crown. A master ceramist hand-layers the final porcelain, and Dr. Pia checks its fit, shade and bite before delivery. Implant surgery is performed by a referred specialist; Dr. Pia provides the crown restoration.

Explore the porcelain crown process and consultation at the Manhattan practice to learn which restorative option fits your tooth and bite.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/dental-crowns/

#DentalCrowns #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Full coverage over a prepared tooth or implant abutment
Crowns when lesser restorations cannot provide suitable support
X-ray and bite evaluation; ceramist fabrication; final fit, shade and bite check
Specialist surgical placement; Dr. Pia restores the implant
limits: Clinical assessment determines the restoration. Implant surgical placement is referred. No longevity guarantee.

title: Dental Inlays and Onlays in NYC
copy:
Dental inlays and onlays in NYC repair a tooth when damage is too extensive for a standard filling but does not require full crown coverage. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, the restoration is made for the prepared tooth and its chewing surface.

An inlay fits within the cusp tips; an onlay covers one or more cusps. Dr. Pia examines the tooth and reviews radiographs to assess damage. Healthy tooth structure is preserved where possible, a temporary protects the prepared tooth, and the final restoration is checked against your bite before bonding.

Read about the treatment stages and consultation at the Manhattan practice to learn which amount of coverage may suit your tooth.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/dental-inlays-onlays/

#InlaysAndOnlays #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Indirect restorations for damage beyond a filling and short of full crown coverage
Inlays fit within cusp tips; onlays cover cusps
Examination, radiographs, conservative preparation, temporary and bite check
limits: Examination determines the extent of damage and appropriate coverage. No diagnosis, universal suitability or lifespan promise.

title: Dental Implants in NYC
copy:
Dental implants in NYC replace missing tooth roots with posts that support a crown or other fixed restoration. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, Dr. Pia designs and delivers the handmade porcelain restoration; referred oral surgeons and periodontists perform implant surgery.

Restorative options include a single implant crown, an implant-supported bridge or a full-arch restoration. The plan depends on the missing teeth, bone and gum health, and bite. Dr. Pia takes over the restorative phase after the surgical specialist confirms integration.

Explore the two-provider treatment process and arrange a consultation at the Manhattan practice to discuss your restorative options and surgical evaluation.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/dental-implants/

#DentalImplants #CosmeticDentistryNYC #NYC
claims: Implants replace missing roots and support restorations
Dr. Pia delivers handmade porcelain; referred specialists perform surgery
Single crowns, implant-supported bridges and full-arch prosthetics
Bone, gum health, bite and specialist integration review determine the plan
limits: Dr. Pia does not perform implant surgery. Surgical evaluation and integration confirmation are required before the restorative phase. No universal eligibility or success promise.

title: Dental Cleaning in NYC
copy:
Dental cleaning in NYC at Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb is reserved for patients who have completed cosmetic restorative treatment with Dr. Pia. These visits support hygiene and monitoring of her veneers, crowns, inlays and onlays.

The visit includes an evaluation of teeth, gums, restorations and bite relationships, followed by deposit removal and polishing appropriate to the restorative materials. Home care guidance is tailored to your dental work, and the cleaning interval is based on your individual oral health and restorations.

Existing restorative patients can contact the Manhattan office about a hygiene visit. Cleanings are not offered as a standalone service to new general dentistry patients. Read the service page for details.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/dental-cleaning/

limits: Existing Dr. Pia restorative patients only. No invitation to book standalone general dental cleaning for new patients.

title: Night Guards in NYC
copy:
Night guards in NYC are custom oral appliances that cushion the forces of grinding and clenching to help protect teeth and dental restorations. At Cosmetic Dentistry NYC - Dr. Pia Lieb, guards are made from impressions of your teeth and fitted to your bite.

A protective night guard and a TMJ splint serve different purposes. A night guard does not stop grinding itself; a TMJ appliance is designed around jaw support and function. The type and material depend on the clinical findings, and a poorly fitting appliance can worsen symptoms.

Explore custom night guards and TMJ guards at the Manhattan practice, then arrange an examination to discuss which appliance may fit your teeth and jaw needs.

Learn more:
https://www.cosmeticdentistrynyc.com/night-guards-nyc/
